item.title: Healthy Homecoming Walk
item.description:
Healthy Homecoming Walk mappalan Tue, 09/22/2026 - 14:21

Is cramming for midterms giving you screen fatigue? It's time to swap the energy drain for fresh fall air and a quick reset! Drop by in between classes to enjoy live music from Impact89FM, yard games, and fitness stations. Be sure to visit the Resource Fair from 11:30 a.m. to 1:30 p.m. to learn about campus health resources and snag free swag. While you are with us, log your laps walked or rolled to push MSU to the top of the global university leaderboard! This event is led by University Health and Well-Being, University Activities Board, and the Exercise is Medicine on Campus RSO.

Demonstration Field (Rain Location: Student Recreation and Wellness Center)

Event Dates
Wednesday, October 7th, 2026 - 9:00AM to Wednesday, October 7th, 2026 - 2:00PM

item.title: Banned Books Beyond the Ban: Voices Uncensored
item.description:
Banned Books Beyond the Ban: Voices Uncensored mappalan Mon, 09/28/2026 - 11:29

Celebrate censored voices by learning about banned books with GSCC and MSU Libraries. Enjoy a selection of pastries while connecting with fellow students and engage in conversations about intellectual freedom and access to information and the stories behind them. Bring your own book to personalize with colorful sprayed edges and bedazzlements. Participants will also have the chance to enter an opportunity drawing to win banned books and take home custom tote bags and other giveaways! Food, supplies, and giveaways are available while supplies last. 


Multicultural Center Room 1015 & 1020

Tuesday, October 13th, 2026 - 6:00PM to Tuesday, October 13th, 2026 - 8:00PM

item.title: Green and White Night ft. Famticipation
item.description:
Green and White Night ft. Famticipation mappalan Mon, 09/28/2026 - 11:43

This Family Weekend, experience hit songs like you've never heard them before. Professional cellist and entertainer Dan Radin takes the stage for a show full of reimagined chart-toppers, original compositions and even some comedic storytelling. Dan's uniquely modern take on a classic instrument makes for a show that students and family alike won't want to miss!

The first show begins in the MSU Union Ballroom (second floor) at 6 p.m., and the second show at 7 p.m.

 

Also make sure to check out Famticipation - a small sample of the amazing student organizations MSU has to offer. Hosted by the Office of Spartan Experiences.

 

 All MSU students and their families are welcome. Join us at the MSU Union for a night of fun during Family Weekend!

 

MSU Union

6 pm - 8 pm

Friday, October 16th, 2026 - 6:00PM to Friday, October 16th, 2026 - 8:00PM
